title: prune.json
description: The record of a prune run, saved as prune.json in the generated standards folder beside its SKILL.md. doctor reads it to tell when a rule was measured on a model the harness no longer defaults to.

standards_path.description: Repo-relative path of the standards folder that was pruned.

commit.description: The target repo commit every run branched from, read from the runs' base_commit. finish refuses when the runs disagree.

batch.description: Runs per arm per harness in each batch.

delete_threshold.description: The no-rule arm must comply at least this often in every harness for a rule to be deleted.

keep_margin.description: An arm is kept when it fails at most this many more times than the best arm, in every harness.

provisional.description: Why the decisions may change: a requested harness that did not run, because it was skipped, not on PATH or not logged in, or a grader that did not pass calibration. null when every requested harness ran and calibration passed.

kind.description: Who graded. judgment-model: one grader, a judgment model, answered every question. subagent: one grader that is not a judgment model, such as a fresh subagent that did not write the probe. consensus: two graders vote and a third breaks ties. Whether the grader can be trusted is recorded in calibration, not here.

consensus.description: How often the first two graders agreed on an output. It stands in for the calibration against human labels and is weaker than it, because two graders can share a bias.

graders.description: Grader names: the two voters in order, then the tiebreaker when there is one. Data only.

agreed.description: Outputs where the two voters gave the same verdict.

tiebroken.description: Outputs where the voters split and the tiebreaker decided.

model.description: The grading model's ID, when known. Data only.

labeled.description: Outputs a human labeled. At least 30.

agreed.description: Outputs where the first grader's yes or no matched the human label.

passed.description: true when agreement is at least 0.9.

calibration.description: The first grader scored against human labels passed to finish --calibration. null when no labels were given, which makes every decision provisional.

harnesses.description: Every harness considered, including skipped ones.

model.description: The model ID the harness ran on. Data only.

model_pinned.description: true when the run pinned this model instead of the harness default. A pinned model says nothing about the default, so doctor cannot call it stale against the default. Absent means the default.

status.description: skipped when it could not authenticate or run headless. A skipped harness never counts as complying.

reason.description: Why it was skipped. null when it ran.

rules.description: One entry per § probed, with its decision.

rule.description: The one-liner as it stood when probed.

probe.description: The probe task, word for word, so a rerun uses the same one.

decision.description: delete: the no-rule arm complied at least 90% in every harness. one-liner: the index line is enough. full: the § must be read before writing. weak: even the best arm fails more than once per batch, so the rule needs a check a tool runs.

provisional.description: true when the decision rests on fewer harnesses than were requested, or on a grader that did not pass calibration.

lift.description: Compliance with the rule minus compliance without it, for each rule arm that ran, per harness and pooled over harnesses (harness all). The writing-side value of the rule. Empty for a deleted rule, because its rule arms never ran.

none.description: Compliance rate of the none arm.

reason.description: One sentence tying the tallies to the decision.

runs.description: Every graded run, one entry each.

model.description: The model ID this run used. Data only.

model_pinned.description: true when this run pinned the model instead of taking the harness default.

date.description: When the run finished, in RFC 3339 form.

run.description: 1-based index within this section, arm and harness.

grader_confidence.description: The judgment model's probability for its verdict, when it graded.

votes.description: Each grader's verdict on this output, in grader order. The recorded complied value is their consensus.
